title: InngestFunction
description: A deployed Inngest function. Defines one or more triggers (event names, crons) and is implemented in user code via the TypeScript, Python, Go, or Kotlin SDK.

slug.description: Stable slug used to address the function in API calls.

name.description: Human-readable name shown in the dashboard.

triggers.description: List of triggers that invoke the function.

event.description: Event name that triggers the function.

cron.description: Cron expression that schedules the function.

expression.description: Optional CEL expression filtering the trigger.
